feat(activity): implement list, list demand, and delete end-to-end
commitResults.messageBody:
Wire the Branch 2 activity commands through every layer:

- ActivityList: canonical view sorted by date then start time (stable
  ties keep add order), demand view grouped HIGH to LOW with canonical
  tie order, and deleteByDisplayedIndex that resolves 1-based indexes
  against the canonical view and removes by object, not raw position
- ListCommand and ListDemandCommand render pre-sorted views through the
  new ActivityListFormatter (pure static formatting, no console I/O)
- DeleteCommand resolves the index via the model and surfaces
  InvalidIndexException [WARNING] messages through the console handler
- ListDeleteCommandParser validates list/list demand/delete syntax with
  the plain-positive-integer rule (rejects "+3" and int-overflowing
  indexes); range checking stays in the model; Parser dispatches the
  two command words

Decisions agreed with the team before implementation: canonical order
(date then start time, stable ties), demand presentation HIGH to LOW,
and delete resolving 1-based displayed indexes against the canonical
view with range checks in the model.
